description: The copy sites the library's texts were taken from (owner's instructions 2026-11-14 §3: «Hide all copy sites»). No source line, label, note or heading of a legal-search tool's output may contain one, and no model-facing content file may name one; statutory text is not scanned (the law says «المحامي الأردني»). Never list the product's own names (عقل, AQEL, اقرأ للمحاماة).
built_from: jordanian-law/references/docs/markdown/*/*.md (the pages listed in each folder's _metadata.json): frontmatter `source` (jordan-lawyer.com), `source_name` («حُماة الحق للمحاماة») and `author` («حُماة الحق»)
jordanian-law/references/docs/catalog/*.json: `author`, the site title «حماة الحق - محامي الأردن»
match: a name matches where it occurs as a substring after Arabic diacritics (U+064B-U+0652, U+0670) and tatweel (U+0640) are removed from both, Latin letters compared case-insensitively
